summary: Signed no-stopping campus lane beside a university building; no pull-off.
reasons: No stopping at all times sign at kerb

best_section.where: Eastern kerb of Campbell Road, north of the Social Sciences Building, St Lucia

drivers.seclusion: No homes; campus buildings and foot traffic all round, so not discreet.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane is narrow with building and trees on the kerb side; no room to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Campus road with pedestrian crossings; cars park on the opposite side.
drivers.convention: No Stopping At All Times signs on this kerb; paid traffic area Mon-Fri.

flags: No stopping at all times, authorised vehicles excepted
sun_shade: Partly shaded by trees and the building on the east side.
